[P2] Preserve the cached asynchronous outcome when `then` becomes non-callable

For an async callback, a wrapper doing `const p = next(); Object.defineProperty(p, "then", { value: undefined }); return p;` makes this path classify the exposed native promise as synchronous. `checkCallback()` subsequently resolves another promise with `p`; its non-callable `then` prevents assimilation, so `withDurableExecution` returns the promise object instead of the invocation output. The base revision directly awaits that native promise and obtains the correct output. Reuse the cached asynchronous outcome when the wrapper returns its exposed `next()` promise, and add a non-callable-`then` case alongside the existing mutation tests.
